brief.scope: Adjudicate the supplied original review against this exact original snapshot. Read the report verbatim and the artifact it reviewed; do not inspect later refs, live repositories, later reviews, fixes, concessions or other dispatch state. Rule UPHELD/PARTIAL/REJECTED on every finding, grounded in commands against this snapshot, then state what the reviewer missed separately. No edits to the snapshot, tests, runtime, full floor, vendor call or authority change. Write the complete ruling to out/RULING.md and name it in artifacts; return a valid review envelope with exact SHA and bounded remedies. The adversarial-review job is used for adjudication because the documented wrapper always passes scope and therefore refuses the no-scope adjudicate job.

findings.claim: UPHELD. launch_id is discovery ID (^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}$) and cannot hold dispatch record id <UTC stamp>-<stage>-<harness>-<6 hex> (e.g. 20260906T103421Z-code-codex-20aa14: uppercase, 34 bytes). No descriptor field binds the descriptor to that record; model observation and custody still rely on it (lines 366-367 and 400, not the reviewer's 384). Bounded remedy: keep caller-reserved launch_id as ID and add a nullable execution-record field in the CONTRACT.md:469 grammar, declaring that the canonical record stores launch_id and the descriptor digest.
findings.reproduce: sed -n '325,327p;336p;366,367p;400p' ops/conductor/conductor-start-plan.md; sed -n '74p' ops/conductor/discovery-lever.md; sed -n '469p' ops/devlane/dispatch/CONTRACT.md; python3 -c "import re; s='20260906T103421Z-code-codex-20aa14'; print(bool(re.match(r'^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,31}$',s)), len(s))"

findings.claim: UPHELD. harness-capabilities.md:209 and probes-lever.md:258/323 cite a startup type Selection that conductor-start-plan.md never names; it only has an inline selection row (line 338). Discovery already owns Selection as the handoff-cardinality object (discovery-lever.md:490-492), which is what lane_start returns. Bounded remedy: name the startup object distinctly (e.g. ConductorSelection) in the startup table and use that name in the other two files.
findings.reproduce: sed -n '209p' ops/conductor/harness-capabilities.md; sed -n '258p;323p' ops/conductor/probes-lever.md; sed -n '338p' ops/conductor/conductor-start-plan.md; sed -n '490,492p' ops/conductor/discovery-lever.md

findings.claim: UPHELD. This change narrowed Conventions to Every probes.py verb is a read but left Exits absolute: Nothing here can Abort (lines 150-153). The added live section then declares a supervision abort with exit 3 (lines 294-295). One contract file states both. Bounded remedy: scope the abort prohibition to run/ask/grade row commands and state that the live diagnostic uses the four-class table including exit 3.

UPHELD. Descriptor adapter is {revision,grammar_sha256,executable_sha256,config_sha256}; identity adapter is {revision,mechanism,config_sha256,grammar_sha256,normalizer_sha256}. Line 242 requires them to match with no map. Request binding_sha256 is the descriptor digest (permission-surface.md:97-99), so the pinned normalizer is outside that digest. Bounded remedy: add normalizer_sha256 and mechanism to the descriptor adapter, or write the field map including executable_sha256 = harness.executable.sha256.
findings.reproduce: sed -n '103,105p;215,216p;242p' ops/conductor/harness-capabilities.md; sed -n '342p' ops/conductor/conductor-start-plan.md; sed -n '96,99p' ops/conductor/permission-surface.md

findings.claim: UPHELD. evaluate_tool is frozen as the policy-side entry while Policy lives once in lane-policy.md#bootstrap-and-minimum-complete-activation. That heading exists (line 390); evaluate_tool does not (grep -c is 0). Nothing in the four owned files records that bucket 1a still owes the counterpart. Bounded remedy: one sentence in permission-surface.md that evaluate_tool awaits the lane-policy counterpart; do not edit lane-policy.md here.
findings.reproduce: sed -n '78,79p;88p' ops/conductor/permission-surface.md; grep -c evaluate_tool ops/conductor/lane-policy.md; sed -n '390p;417p' ops/conductor/lane-policy.md

findings.claim: UPHELD. cleanup is complete, failed or unreachable, but exits name only complete (exit 0) and cleanup failure (exit 1). An all-PASS run whose cleanup could not be observed has no declared exit class. Bounded remedy: map cleanup=unreachable onto exit 1 or exit 3 in that same paragraph.

UPHELD. Prose now governs Tokens after the first -- (lines 85-87) while the synopsis (lines 78-83) still shows four forms with no -- position and no optional token group. Whether the two test forms admit forwarding is unstated. Bounded remedy: add [-- <token>...] to each form that forwards, and say whether the test forms accept --.

UPHELD. The frozen Decision example sets needed to use canonical dispatch; run the independent doctor for gate diagnosis. Serializing onto the wire (docs/wire.md:20) and splitting on ;  yields four segments, not expected-found-needed. The startup example at conductor-start-plan.md:408-409 avoids this. Bounded remedy: remove the inner ;  from that needed template.
findings.reproduce: sed -n '146p' ops/conductor/permission-surface.md; sed -n '408,409p' ops/conductor/conductor-start-plan.md; sed -n '20p' docs/wire.md; python3 -c "line='conductor-tool: expected declared conductor operation; found direct-edit; needed use canonical dispatch; run the independent doctor for gate diagnosis'; print(len(line.split('; ')), line.split('; '))"

findings.claim: Missed by the original review. invariant_sha256 hashes {selection,grants,adapter,forwarded_tokens,mcp} from transport, but adapter is not identified among the argv manifest, descriptor adapter, or identity adapter. Resume compares this digest to retained launch evidence. Bounded remedy: name which adapter object is hashed and list its keys.

Missed by the original review. The identity section says the live report supplies checked_at, results and digest-backed evidence, but the closed observation object (probes-lever.md:252-263) has no results key; outcomes are cases and counts. Bounded remedy: say cases (and counts) instead of results; do not add a results field.
